summary: MacroGenics (MGNX) entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement to sell its CDMO operations, including its manufacturing facility in Rockville, MD and warehouse in Frederick, MD, to Bora Pharmaceuticals for $122.5 million in cash at closing, subject to working capital and indebtedness adjustments, plus up to $5 million in milestone payments for manufacturing and professional development services in 2027-2028. The board approved the deal, and closing is expected in Q3 2026, subject to customary conditions. At closing, ancillary agreements including a manufacturing/supply agreement and sublease will be executed. Watch for regulatory clearance and any competing offers.
